steps.code:
# The files are listed with full paths. I need to reorganize them from "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>" to "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>".
# I will parse each file path, extract date, file_name, and extension, then move the file to the new path accordingly.
import os

for file_path in files:
    # Extract the filename from the full path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split the filename into date and rest by "__"
    date_part, rest = filename.split("__", 1)
    # Split rest into file_name and extension
    file_name, extension = os.path.splitext(rest)
    # Remove leading dot from extension
    extension = extension.lstrip(".")
    # Construct new directory path and new file name
    new_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{file_name}"
    new_file = f"{date_part}.{extension}"
    new_path = f"{new_dir}/{new_file}"
    
    # Create the new directory if it does not exist
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # Move the file to the new path
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_path=file_path, destination_path=new_path)
